tasks.title: Define the required derivative family matrix
tasks.goal: Make general local derivatives concrete across all source interpretations without a demand-permission gate.
steps: Enumerate required CommonMark, XML-data, Vibe-spec, opaque file and nested-tree cases, including code-bearing bytes treated as data.
Map existing composition/replacement/export mechanisms to each family; identify exact missing behavior and owning library rather than proposing a parallel priority language.
Create PROP-061 anchors and fixture manifests that distinguish base identity, local ownership, compatibility targets and downstream activation.
positive_cases: Every required family has a meaningful local modification/replacement scenario.
A sealed source permits a separately owned local derivative.
negative_cases: Text-only support cannot close general resource scope.
Neither absent demand evidence nor a sealed flag may become a new permission gate.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-agent-projection target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-agent-projection <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-specdoc <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- facts check --exhaustive only when actual facts/adoption/reference/extraction or closure-contract impact requires exhaustive validation. Otherwise bind affected claim/source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.
acceptance: Canonical family matrix names actual source mechanisms and executable case requirements.
No original capture or upstream identity is edited.
tasks.safe_stop: Family scope and canonical derivative contract are reviewable before implementation.

tasks.title: Choose one reusable derivative operation boundary
tasks.goal: Integrate derive operations with source proof and artifact ownership instead of adding another truth store.
steps: Trace source capture, existing composition output and downstream artifact/deploy ownership for two contrasting fixture families.
Define derive/show/diff/rebase/apply service boundaries and immutable input/output carriers using M-01/M-16; record which values are authored versus disposable output.
Add a small operation harness proving passive replacement and projection inspection never execute code or mutate installed source slots.
positive_cases: One inert text replacement and one opaque tree use the same domain lifecycle.
Source provenance remains available after deleting disposable derived output.
negative_cases: A derived cache cannot become the sole home of local authored source.
Derivation cannot secretly hydrate, execute a script or reuse upstream grants.
